tasks.title: Promote the access schema and Permission catalogue migration
tasks.dod: The staged migration is promoted, applies and reverts cleanly, and its database constraints and catalogue seed pass integration checks.

tasks.title: Implement access domain invariants and Unicode names
tasks.dod: Domain tests prove Unicode name rules, custom/protected Role rules, reserved Permission rules, assignment replacement, and manager-transfer invariants.

tasks.title: Implement access persistence entities and repositories
tasks.dod: Repository integration tests prove Warehouse-scoped reads, fresh principal resolution, atomic Role replacement, provisioning rollback, and concurrency-safe manager transfer.

tasks.title: Extend registration with atomic Warehouse provisioning
tasks.dod: Registration contract, command, controller, and integration tests prove complete creation or complete rollback and return immediate access only after commit.

tasks.title: Enforce fresh Warehouse-scoped authorization
tasks.dod: Guard and architecture tests deny stale, missing, or cross-Warehouse authority and fail when an authenticated business handler lacks explicit Permission metadata and scoping classification.

tasks.title: Implement custom Role lifecycle commands
tasks.dod: Command tests prove authorized create/update/rename behavior, exact-name uniqueness, empty Permission sets, protected Role rejection, and no changes after denial.

tasks.title: Implement member assignment and atomic Role deletion
tasks.dod: Command and transaction tests prove safe ordinary assignment, protected-manager rejection, same-Warehouse enforcement, replacement deletion, unassigned deletion, and full rollback on failure.

tasks.title: Implement atomic Warehouse Manager transfer
tasks.dod: Command and concurrency tests prove only the current authorized manager can atomically transfer to a different same-Warehouse member while exactly one manager remains.

tasks.title: Expose scoped access read endpoints
tasks.dod: Shared-contract and REST tests prove current capability, Role, Permission, and member pages are bounded, permission-gated, current-Warehouse scoped, and non-disclosing on denial.

tasks.title: Expose access mutation endpoints and normalized failures
tasks.dod: Contract and REST tests cover every Role, assignment, deletion, and manager-transfer operation with the specified status, safe error code, authorization metadata, and current-Warehouse routing.

tasks.title: Add Warehouse registration to the approved sign-up UI
tasks.dod: Desktop and mobile component tests prove the approved Warehouse-name field, accessible localized validation, loading, atomic success, and atomic failure states against the shared contract.

tasks.title: Build the approved access review workspace
tasks.dod: Responsive route tests prove the approved Roles/Members/Permissions workspace fetches and retains only authorized datasets, hides unavailable navigation, and meets keyboard and screen-reader requirements.

tasks.title: Build approved access administration workflows
tasks.dod: Responsive interaction tests prove accessible Role editing, member assignment, assigned-Role replacement, manager transfer, capability refresh, and normalized race-denial feedback using the approved design system.

tasks.title: Gate access security, atomicity, and performance
tasks.dod: Release gates pass for lifecycle atomicity, next-decision revocation, catalogue reconciliation, authorization coverage, p95 latency targets, and 50 protected operations per second for 10 minutes.
